# Ria Pet Mart

> Pet shop in Bandar Bukit Beruntung, Rawang, Selangor, Malaysia (since 2016). Cat food, dog food, treats, cat litter, supplements and NexGard flea & tick protection, with same-day delivery in Selangor, Kuala Lumpur and Putrajaya (order by 1pm, Monday to Saturday), nationwide courier delivery, and free store pickup. Online shop: https://www.riapetmart.com

## Shop facts
- Address: 57, Jalan Jenjarum 3B, Bandar Bukit Beruntung, 48300 Rawang, Selangor, Malaysia
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 to 19:00 (closed Sunday)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +60 19-611 2848
- Payment: FPX online banking, GrabPay, cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay
- Also at the shop: pet grooming and a Cat Hotel (cat boarding)
- Partner vet: Animal Health Clinic (Klinik Kesihatan Haiwan), G9, Jalan Trompet 14, Seksyen BB7, Bukit Beruntung, open Monday to Saturday 9:30 to 18:00, +60 18-232 2014
